questions.q: What does a data access set primarily secure?
options: Which pages a user can open
Access to one or more ledgers or ledger sets, down to balancing segment values
Which privileges exist in the system
Password complexity rules
questions.explain: A data access set is General Ledger's mechanism for scoping access to ledgers or ledger sets, optionally down to specific balancing segment values.

questions.q: By default, what access does a data access set grant when a ledger is first created?
options: No access to anyone
Read-only access to one balancing segment value
Access only to the Cash Manager job role
Full read-and-write access to the entire ledger
questions.explain: Every ledger automatically gets a data access set with full read-and-write access to the whole ledger; narrower data access sets must be deliberately defined.

questions.q: Castellan Robotics wants its East Division controller to see only East Division transactions within the company's single shared ledger. What is the right tool?
options: Create a completely separate ledger just for the East Division
Remove the controller's job role entirely
Define a data access set scoped to the East Division's balancing segment value
Disable function security for all other divisions
questions.explain: A data access set can restrict a user to specific balancing segment values within one shared ledger, avoiding the need for a separate ledger per division.

questions.q: Concretely, what does a data security policy's 'condition' usually amount to?
options: A filter, such as a rule limiting rows to a matching business unit, enforced automatically when the policy's role is provisioned
A manual approval step a human must complete each time
A hard-coded list of user names
A password expiration rule
questions.explain: A condition is implemented as a filter on the underlying data (e.g., rows matching the user's business unit), applied transparently whenever the user queries that data.

questions.q: How is a data access set typically attached to a user in practice?
options: It cannot be attached to a user at all
By editing the chart of accounts directly
Only through a privilege granted to an abstract role
Through a data role or direct assignment via Manage Data Access for Users
questions.explain: A data access set is associated with a role (often a data role) or assigned directly to a user through the Manage Data Access for Users task, covered hands-on in Lesson 8.
